selection: Selected a dense exact-ID-absence cluster whose submitted Appwrite branch hostnames contain model names, plus one ordinary Appwrite site control. The purpose was to test whether the apparent labels connected distinguishable participants or task-result dependencies. Selection followed the original scanner backlog rather than a reported incident or intentional agent community. It is a purposive bounded sample, not a census or participant count.

assessed_groups.assessment: Every successful model-named branch read records the submitted branch host returning HTTP 303 and then a common Appwrite marketing, account and authorization footprint, with CDN, account API, analytics and payment assets. None exposes the deployed branch body, a task result, a sender-to-recipient reference, a recorded channel, a second autonomous participant or downstream use. A small number of recorded Appwrite and analytics POST requests are ordinary browser network metadata here; their bodies and semantics are absent and they cannot be treated as agent messages.
assessed_groups.identity_limit: Appwrite documents that Git deployments receive generated branch and commit URLs and that a branch URL is tied to a source-control branch. A branch label containing 'Claude' or 'Gemini' therefore authenticates only a branch-name string in this evidence, not a model invocation, autonomous agent, provider execution or operator.
assessed_groups.access_limit: Appwrite documents preview deployments as private to authorized project or organization members. No account was created, no authentication was attempted and no preview body was accessed.
alternatives: One operator's deployment tests or scanner retries
Repeated reads of an Appwrite authorization surface
A project built with AI assistance but not autonomous coordination
assessed_groups.next_evidence_required: An already public underlying repository, commit or preserved deployment record must first show a specific autonomous sender producing an artifact or instruction. A later independently distinguishable recipient must demonstrably retrieve and use that result, followed by primary evidence that the cooperation crossed an operator-defined boundary. A model token in a branch label is insufficient for every step.

assessed_groups.assessment: The older hash-named Appwrite site records first-party page loads plus Appwrite account, analytics, telemetry and registry traffic. It contains no decoded task language, participant exchange or downstream task-result use. It is retained as a platform control, not an agent record.

Three model-named branch records and one official-site record timed out without returning original JSON. They remain uninspected and inconclusive; they are not negative findings and were not repeatedly retried.
assessed_groups.next_step: Retain the four public report links as cursors. Resume only during a later bounded pass if the ordinary read route is available; do not authenticate to a preview, replay a request or treat timeout status as evidence.

official_platform_context.finding: Git deployments receive generated branch and commit URLs; branch previews require authorized project or organization access.
Appwrite describes automatically generated domains, including consistent URLs for deployments from a specific branch.

performed: Exact-ID join against the pinned Transluce comparison release
novelty_audit.result: All 30 selected IDs are absent from the pinned comparison release, but the 26 successful reads do not preserve a concrete coordination chain. No broad prior-reporting search for a purported new swarm was performed because there is no episode to audit. Dataset absence is not treated as novelty.

attribution_and_activity: No independently verified autonomous participant, provider attribution, operator-boundary violation, subjective rogue intent or ongoing coordination is established.
safety: Read only existing public urlquery report JSON and official Appwrite documentation. No deployment preview, recovered code, carrier, target, sink, request, runtime or package was executed; no scan, account, authentication, message, vote or participant contact occurred. Publication omits payload bodies, recorded request paths, credentials, tokens, personal addresses and sink topics.
